decisions.question: Gate 3 for batch D3, delegated under the standing instruction of 2026-10-01: Lev, Yara, Nika, Radek and Oss are in the running game at the Star Monastery, Thornwatch, the High Pass, the Bell Foundry and the Lantern Ferry (board 127.0.0.1:47895, _reviews/gate3-residents-d3). Rig, weights and clips are identical in both candidates, both are quantized and meshopt-compressed, and both pass the per-frame verifier on every 60 Hz frame of Idle and Talk. Measured cost: the five GLBs add 2.66 MB (2.43 MB as served) and all 28 preloaded models total 20.1 MB. On the RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, p50 is equal or lower in all 20 scene and quality pairs and draw calls fall by 26 to 52 per scene; in SwiftShader p50 is up to 2.8% higher. Calibrated lifts all five to their concepts' brightness; the lift reddens Oss's painted back and brightens Radek's teal hem speckles. As cooked, they stay at 55% to 65% of their concepts. This is not AAA: faces are soft, hands are mittens, the backs are projected paintings, PBR maps are derived from colour, and only procedural Idle and Talk exist. Which should I ship?
